headline: France Enters Recession After GDP Contracts 0.2% in Third Quarter
summary: France's gross domestic product shrank 0.2% in the third quarter following a downwardly revised contraction in the second quarter, confirming the eurozone's second-biggest economy has entered a recession.
why: France is a primary engine of the eurozone economy; economic contractions signal weakened regional consumer demand and fiscal strain.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: Two consecutive quarters of economic contraction officially mark a recession.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The downward revision of second-quarter output combined with a 0.2% drop in the third quarter confirmed back-to-back quarters of negative economic growth.
